rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something promising or giving grounds for hope.

example.traditional: 呢個計劃睇落幾有希望。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 tai2 lok6 gei2 jau5 hei1 mong6

rows.note: Use this mainly for encouraging news, results, or developments that hearten people; it is more formal than 有希望.

example.english: This year's economic figures are encouraging.
example.traditional: 今年嘅經濟數據令人鼓舞。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ge3 ging1 zai3 sou3 geoi3 ling6 jan4 gu2 mou5

rows.note: Use this before a noun such as 說話 or 態度 when someone is supportive and gives encouragement.

example.english: Your encouraging words really give me confidence again.
example.traditional: 你呢番鼓勵人嘅說話，真係令我有返信心。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 faan1 gu2 lai6 jan4 ge3 syut3 waa6 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 jau5 faan1 seon3 sam1
